title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}=\left(1-2\lambdaight) {	heta}^t+\alpha \left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {	heta}^tight)ight) X_i$$

Focus on understanding each component of this equation. What happens to $${	heta}^{t+1}$$ when $$X_i$$ is zero?

title: Effect of $$X_i$$ on the Update
text: When $$X_i$$ is zero, the term $$\alpha \left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)\right) X_i$$ becomes zero. How does this affect the update rule?

title: Impact of Regularization
text: Consider the term $$\left(1-2\lambda\right) {\theta}^t$$. How does lambda affect the value of $${\theta}^{t+1}$$? Think about different scenarios where lambda is positive, zero, or negative.

title: Choosing $$y_i$$
text: Given that $$X_i$$ is zero, which value of $$y_i$$ will make $${\theta}^{t+1}$$ the most positive?
